permitted_concrete_review_route: Add isolated versioned study files on a new branch and open a draft PR with exact source/artifact identities, local checks and all unrun qualification disclosed. Normal owner integration and publication gates remain mandatory.
route_scope: Public Git review package can provide version-pinned source and file links; it is not canonical Pages deployment, installed release acceptance or software publication.
full_source_gate: New or changed executable HTML/code requires full source qualification; paper-only overlay only covers exact catalog-referenced passive PDF/TeX and generated allowed surfaces.
companion_route: Canonical repository research-release ZIP with SHA256 and byte length; source-evidence route must name same research release tag.
immutability: Existing original PDFs, sources, catalog/resource identities, prior failures and source-specific qualification remain unchanged. Revised manuscript needs new versioned ID.
owner_hold: Existing sole v1.47 publication lane has runtime readiness failure and PR5007 repair. Do not create another publisher, move main, reserve a competing version, blind-retry jobs or waive gates.
required_final_evidence: Exact reviewed source, configured checks, full resulting-main qualification, immutable package, actual published download byte verification, and canonical served-byte/browser acceptance through existing owner.
authorization_boundary: No spending, customer outreach, financial transaction, credentials/security changes or LinkedIn posting. User authorizes in-scope additive preparation/publication through existing permitted route; LinkedIn remains draft for approval.
